split_method: Stratified 4-Fold Cross-Validation (k=4 chosen because minority class has 4 sample(s), guaranteeing each fold has every class)

baseline_performance.description: Naive majority-class baseline (always predicts most frequent class)

interpretation_note: Model confidence is a statistical output of the classifier on the training distribution, not the probability that a threat is real. Dataset is small (N=15), requiring cross-validation.
